# Euler Problem 241 Solution in Ada

This problem asks us to find the sum of all distinct values of n where n/φ(n) is a perfect square, for n ≤ 10^15.

Let me break down the approach:
- We need to find numbers n such that n/φ(n) is a perfect square
- For a number n with prime factorization n = p₁^a₁ × p₂^a₂ × ... × pₖ^aₖ, we have φ(n) = n × ∏(1 - 1/pᵢ)
- So n/φ(n) = ∏pᵢ/(pᵢ - 1) = ∏(pᵢ - 1 + 1)/(pᵢ - 1) = ∏(1 + 1/(pᵢ - 1))
- For this to be a perfect square, each prime factor contributes appropriately

Here's my Ada solution:

```ada
with Ada.Text_IO; use Ada.Text_IO;
with Ada.Integer_Text_IO; use Ada.Integer_Text_IO;
with Ada.Long_Long_Integer_Text_IO; use Ada.Long_Long_Integer_Text_IO;

procedure Euler_241 is
   type Long_Long is new Long_Long_Integer;
   
   -- Function to compute greatest common divisor
   function GCD(a, b : Long_Long) return Long_Long is
   begin
      if b = 0 then
         return a;
      else
         return GCD(b, a mod b);
      end if;
   end GCD;
   
   -- Function to check if a number is a perfect square
   function Is_Perfect_Square(n : Long_Long) return Boolean is
      root : Long_Long := Long_Long(Integer(Sqrt(Real(n)) + 0.5));
   begin
      return root * root = n;
   end Is_Perfect_Square;
   
   -- Function to compute φ(n) using prime factorization
   function Phi(n : Long_Long) return Long_Long is
      result : Long_Long := n;
      i : Long_Long := 2;
   begin
      while i * i <= n loop
         if n mod i = 0 then
            result := result - (result / i);
            while n mod i = 0 loop
               n := n / i;
            end loop;
         end if;
         i := i + 1;
      end loop;
      
      if n > 1 then
         result := result - (result / n);
      end if;
      
      return result;
   end Phi;
   
   -- Function to compute n/φ(n)
   function Ratio(n : Long_Long) return Long_Long is
      phi_n : Long_Long := Phi(n);
   begin
      return n / GCD(n, phi_n);
   end Ratio;
   
   -- Brute force approach for small cases
   function Solve_Limited(limit : Long_Long) return Long_Long is
      sum : Long_Long := 0;
      i : Long_Long := 1;
      found : Boolean;
   begin
      while i <= limit loop
         declare
            ratio : Long_Long := Ratio(i);
         begin
            if Is_Perfect_Square(ratio) then
               sum := sum + i;
               Put_Line("Found: " & Long_Long'image(i) & " -> n/φ(n) = " & Long_Long'image(ratio));
            end if;
         end;
         i := i + 1;
      end loop;
      return sum;
   end Solve_Limited;
